class.name: OpenWorldVine3D
class.brief_description: Displays one baked unique vine with distance LOD.
class.description: Switches a variant mesh at a configurable interval. This node does not regenerate paths at runtime.

method.name: force_lod_update
method.description: Immediately resolves camera distance and mesh.

method.name: get_current_lod
method.description: Returns current LOD or -1 when culled.

signal.name: support_detach_requested
signal.description: Emitted for SUPPORT_DETACH. Gameplay code decides how to animate or replace the vine.
